identity: Keep (Dataset ID, Source Sample ID, Variant ID) and existing monotonically allocated Variant IDs; opaque CRS IDs remain variant-local.
dedup: Reuse order-preserving semantic_trajectory: expand selection descriptors/owner references and normalize opaque names. Never erase EDGE/FACE execution order.
fingerprint: A versioned trajectory digest is an integrity/dedup field, not a replacement primary identity or a neural pointer target.
equivalence: Maintain a separate equivalence record linking distinct trajectories after shared causal prefix, physical selected-set/owner binding, and authoritative STEP action/result comparison pass.
frozen_regeneration: Regeneration targets a frozen manifest of approved trajectories and artifacts. Unexpected OCC order becomes an explicit new-variant candidate; it never silently replaces the requested frozen variant.
deterministic_admission: For a newly frozen generation, sort verified trajectory fingerprints when allocating new manifest entries. Preserve already assigned Variant IDs and record append-only provenance. This sorts manifest entries, not selections.
required_provenance: prefix geometry and locator/owner binding evidence
scope: A future dataset-level decision. This task preserves CRS ID and action contracts and does not implement a new variant scheduler.
